schema_per_checkpoint_line.timestamp_iso: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at checkpoint emit
schema_per_checkpoint_line.total_cells: Total cube cells planned (217 * 26 = 5642 for Phase 1)
schema_per_checkpoint_line.cumulative_trades: Total trades in trade_log so far (int)
schema_per_checkpoint_line.cumulative_win_rate: Cumulative win rate 0.0-1.0 (or null if no trades)
schema_per_checkpoint_line.tier: STOP-S3 tier classification: OK / LOG-MEDIUM / WARN-HIGH / HALT-CRITICAL
schema_per_checkpoint_line.tier_reasons: List of human-readable reasons for tier (empty if OK)
schema_per_checkpoint_line.a1_anomalies_top_5: Top 5 strategies with highest deviation ratio

stop_tier_definitions.LOG-MEDIUM: Single-strategy outlier / non-required NaN; log + continue
stop_tier_definitions.WARN-HIGH: Fire-count >2x baseline OR cumulative-WR delta >5pp OR fires/day >2x; warn first occurrence + halt at 2nd consecutive
stop_tier_definitions.HALT-CRITICAL: Runtime error / segfault / corruption / NaN propagation / schema violation / writer failure; INSTANT HALT
